lessonTitle: 35. The surface area of a cone
lessonTitleEnglish: The surface area of a cone
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: The lateral surface of a cone unrolls into a sector of radius l with arc 2πr, so S(lateral) = πrl.
stages.headlineEnglish: The lateral surface of a cone unrolls into a sector of radius l with arc 2πr, so S(lateral) = πrl.

stages.headline: The total surface area is S = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).
stages.headlineEnglish: The total surface area is S = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

stages.headline: Example: r = 3, h = 4 gives l = 5, S(lateral) = 15π and S(total) = 15π + 9π = 24π.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: r = 3, h = 4 gives l = 5, S(lateral) = 15π and S(total) = 15π + 9π = 24π.
